tools.quote: Refrain from using or adopting AI tools that process institutional or personal data without appropriate review and approval.

data.quote: Refrain from using or adopting AI tools that process institutional or personal data without appropriate review and approval.

safeguards.quote: Use AI technologies—whether institutionally supported or externally adopted—in accordance with privacy, academic integrity, and ethical guidelines.

legal.quote: All institutionally adopted AI tools must comply with Canadian privacy requirements (e.g., PIPEDA) and institutional privacy policies.
